application_channel: Apply online through the official Antigua and Barbuda eVisa portal and obtain approval before travel. Conditional VOA is limited to eligible holders of a valid US, Canadian, UK or Schengen visa/residence card who meet every published condition.
application_fee: eVisa fee varies by type; see portal. Conditional VOA: USD 100 or equivalent EC per passenger (children included).
processing_time: 7 working days; may extend to 15 days, exceptionally 30. Apply at least 7 working days before travel.

official_immigration_source_name: Antigua and Barbuda Department of Immigration — Countries Exempt from Visa
cross_check_source_name: Antigua and Barbuda Consulate General in New York — Applying for a Visa
review_notes: Bangladesh is not listed in the Department of Immigration's visa-exempt country lists; that page states that nationals of countries not appearing on the lists require a visa. The Antigua and Barbuda Consulate General in New York separately names Bangladesh among nationalities requiring a visa. Ordinary Bangladesh passport holders therefore require a tourist visa, with the official eVisa route as the standard route. The Department's specific visa-on-arrival page creates a narrow conditional tourist-VOA exception for qualifying holders of valid US, Canadian, UK or Schengen visas/residence cards who satisfy all stated conditions; this is not general VOA access. The general FAQ warning against arriving without a visa is read together with, and subject to, that specific published exception. The eVisa fee varies by selected type and is displayed in the portal; the conditional tourist VOA fee is USD 100 or equivalent EC currency per passenger including children. The eVisa decision target is 7 working days, may extend to 15 and exceptionally 30; expedited service costs extra but the amount is not published on the reviewed page. The conditional VOA is single-entry for up to 30 days and is non-extendable/non-convertible except specified medical cases. Multiple-entry eVisa validity is one year; other eVisa stay/validity depends on the selected type. Each traveller, including children, requires a separate eVisa application. Photo upload is required; if the uploaded photo is poor quality a photo may be taken on arrival, and fingerprints are taken on arrival. No routine VAC capture is stated.
